description:
My name is Ha Yeonju and I am the happiest person who is getting married. I came to a place with a "breakup club" to do odd jobs. People here ruin other people's relationships on the pretext of a good separation. I'm going to teach these people what true love is.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/GB_meeting), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.nhn?productNo=3360263), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/breakup_gathering)

**Official Translation:**  
[Indonesian](https://id.kakaowebtoon.com/content/Klub-Putus-Cinta/506)
